history.title: Time and Location Skill Revision
history.description: Create a new skill to report the current local time and location provided by the application, with improvements for timezone-awareness and provider handling.
acceptance_tests: The skill reports the correct current local time.
get_current_location(None) returns a structured unavailable result.
get_current_location(provider) returns the provider's non-empty value.

diffs.alice_time_location_skill.py:
--- a/alice_time_location_skill.py
+++ b/alice_time_location_skill.py
@@ -0,0 +1,20 @@
+import datetime
+import pytz
+class TimeAndLocation:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.timezone = pytz.timezone('UTC')
+
+    def get_current_time(self):
+        return datetime.datetime.now(self.timezone)
+
+    def get_current_location(self, provider=None):
+        if provider is None:
+            return {'status': 'unavailable'}
+        else:
+            # Assuming provider is a string or object with location info
+            return {'location': provider}
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    time_and_location = TimeAndLocation()
+    print(time_and_location.get_current_time())
+    print(time_and_location.get_current_location('New York'))
